items.title: ‘Epic Seven’ New “Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine” Hero Out Now
items.summary: This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate rolled out the red carpet for their latest heroine "Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine" in their
items.content:
This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate rolled out the red carpet for their latest heroine “Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine” in their long-running turn-based role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’. Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine is a key character in the Special Side Story “Secret Rabbit Hole,” which has been ongoing since the 29th of October (where it also launched on Steam)! In said story, she appears as a mob boss who leads her syndicate with fierce charisma—ruthless to traitors, yet willing to risk her life to protect her subordinates. What a hero!

She is a 5★ Ice elemental Knight Hero capable of elevating her party’s combat power by decreasing damage suffered by allies, increasing Combat Readiness, and granting Increased Attack. Most notably, she grants herself “Determination” when an ally dies. While granted Determination, using her basic skill “Initiation” will activate “Settlement” as an extra attack, dealing damage that penetrates Defense to all enemies.

Meanwhile, the Special Side Story “Secret Rabbit Hole” will run until 10 December. By progressing through the story, players can acquire three pieces of Level 88 Equipment. Players who collect all three new Bunny Girl Heroes and two skins will also receive a special Pet.

Epic Seven is a free-to-play title that is available across PC (Windows) via Steam / STOVE , iOS (macOS supported), and Android via Google Play .

items.title: Smilegate Devs Speak on Epic Seven's Steam Debut and Chaos Zero Nightmare's Anniversary
items.summary: TWIMG is chock full of interviews this week! Find out what
items.content:
Hello and welcome once more to another edition of This Week in Mobile Games , your twice-monthly look at the wild world of games on your phone and other mobile devices (and more, these days).

Today's installment is a bit special, as I've been learning a bit more about Chaos Zero Nightmare and Epic Seven . Both games are free-to-play titles developed by Smilegate , with Chaos Zero Nightmare (CZN) being the newer one. CZN recently launched its first anniversary celebration, and Epic Seven ( E7) commemorated its eighth birthday earlier this year. More recently, though, the game made its debut on Steam for the first time, and a new server based on the platform went live right alongside the 6th annual Epic Seven World Championship.

In light of the new developments for both titles, I had a chance to send a few questions to developers at Smilegate , namely Epic Seven Producer Tak Gwang-Jin, as well as Choi Seung-Hyuin, who recently took on the role of Producer for Chaos Zero Nightmare . They reflected on their respective games, commenting on Chaos Zero Nightmare 's inspirations and the changes it's gone through since its (admittedly rough) launch last year, and on Epic Seven 's long journey and its growing eSports scene.

Chaos Zero Nightmare Producer Choi Seung-Hyuin on the S.S. Nightmare 's Voyage so Far, and its Year Ahead

ANN: Chaos Zero Nightmare (CZN) features an unusual premise that blends together cosmic horror and science fantasy elements, alongside mechanics that sometimes rely on characters suffering mental breakdowns in the middle of combat to unleash their most powerful abilities. What works inspired the team at Smilegate to explore this core concept?

CHOI and KIM : It's difficult to name just one. Rather than drawing from any single title, our planning team worked hard to incorporate into CZN the elements each member personally found compelling.

There are specific works that inspired us more than others, but we don't limit ourselves by genre. Whether it's a completely unrelated game, a film, or an anime, the planning team shares what they've enjoyed and works to bring it to life in the game.

CZN employs an art style that employs 2D animation-style characters and cutscenes. How did the team decide on this presentation style compared to full 3D character models and environments (which are increasingly popular among free-to-play games)?

CHOI : Over the course of developing Epic Seven , we built up deep expertise in 2D, and that naturally drew in people who are passionate about 2D illustration. I think that team is what made CZN's 2D presentation possible.

CZN is celebrating its first anniversary and has seen a lot of changes between its launch last year and now. Which changes are you most excited to see go live in the game?

CHOI : Our first anniversary is only the beginning. We've been working to fix the problem of Combatants feeling much less useful once a season ends, and the first improvement will arrive in Season 6. Beyond that, the roguelike content will be revamped, and in Season Chaos, we'll make building Save Data less grindy while adding new challenges. The story will also dive into the tale of the gods with twists no one will see coming. A lot is waiting for players, so we hope they'll stay with us and remain excited through our second anniversary.

What is the biggest lesson the team has learned from player feedback and the experience of CZN's live operations in the year so far?

CHOI: When we didn't have enough time to test something properly, players always let us know. Now we check everything much more carefully. Our schedule is much more manageable, and we believe the service has become a lot more stable.

Mr. Choi, what sort of design philosophy are you hoping to bring to the game's future, and what can players of CZN look forward to from your tenure as its producer?

items.title: Epic Seven tier list - for every instance in the game
items.summary: Not every character is meant to play every instance. Therefore, we have ranked all of the characters for each game mode in this Epic Seven tier list.
items.content:
Prefer Pocket Gamer on Google X Facebook Reddit Left Arrow 0 / 7 Right Arrow Updated on November 1st, 2026 - Version 1.0.1023 - Latest Additions: Renoa

In our Epic Seven tier list , you can find all the characters currently available in the game, ranked according to each instance (and how well they're doing instance-wise), so make sure to check the tier list specific to the content you're after.

In Epic Seven, you have one of the best gacha games that I've played, and I've played quite a lot of them! However, similar to many other games out there, you might want to know who the best characters are, because there are plenty of them, and not all perform exceptionally well.

I've personally been playing Epic Seven since its release, and with all the recent updates, new hero changes, and additions, there have been so many changes in terms of tier lists. However, one of the heroes that have been consistently doing well is Ravi, who is absolutely amazing! Different characters for different game modes For PvE stages (the Chapters), you need characters that have clear speed and can tank quite a few shots (one tank), while for PvP Arena, you want someone that can inflict various CC and debuffs, so you will have a completely different team for both. As for Boss Hunt and Abyss, it depends on the situation. There are a few characters that are generally great, but you'll discover more information below.

The PvE stages are the Story stages (campaign mode), and they're fairly simple - the main goal is to add at least a good tank, a healer and some AoE damage in order to clear them quickly and efficiently. As is the custom, in our Epic Seven tier list, characters are sorted from the top down, by their power and general usefulness.

The characters you'll find below are the best possible choices for the Abyss. The Abyss is basically a dungeon with increasing difficulty per floor, so given the circumstances, some heroes might be better than others at certain levels. The rewards are exceptional, though, and it's something every player will have to do at one point or another in the end-game.

Hunt, as it is simply called in Epic Seven, is an instance where you have to defeat bosses to acquire specific upgrade items. It's a PvE instance where you can select which stage you want to fight, so it's particularly important to have the best equipment and characters ready.

Raids are another PvE mode in Epic Seven that requires sturdy and powerful heroes. Azmakalis is one such Raid, and the heroes in SS and S tiers are probably your best choices.

In PvP, you want characters that can deal massive single-target damage or can inflict all kinds of crowd control and debuffs on the enemy. The characters listed below are some of the best for everything PvP-related.

Guilds are an important aspect of Epic Seven, and Guild Wars are a type of content that is available once you join one. Use your best characters, or if you have the means, pick the ones ranked in the SS, S, and A tiers.

So, before you start your actual adventure, make sure you reroll a few times to get one of the top characters listed below. For starters, I would highly suggest you go for one that works great in PvE, such as Sez, Vildred or Angelica, because they will help you out a great deal. You will have plenty of chances to summon more, later on, so don't worry about making your PvP team just yet - instead, focus on a couple of strong characters that can easily help you pass the stages.

A good AoE-focused character you can also get is Ravi, since she can pretty much sustain herself in the battle stages. Others like Achates, Clarissa and Destina work great too, so if you think you're lucky and want to give it a shot, you can also try to go for two 5* ones. If you pull Ken, he can be great later on for your PvP team, while still being relatively okay at the PvE stages.

I'd also suggest that you don't invest too much in characters that are not exactly amazing (so even if you get 5* champions, make sure they are top tier - otherwise, don't bother with them too much at the start), because you'll need all the resources you can get your hands on!

And with that reroll guide, we are closing off our Epic Seven tier list. And since you're such a patient player, we have some gift codes for Epic Seven that you can use! And in case you are interested in where you can download the game and the latest updates for it, head off to the official website !

items.title: ‘Epic Seven’ Out Now on Steam, World Championship Knockout Stage Details
items.summary: Today, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate announced that their free-to-play turn-based strategy role-playing game title 'Epic Seven' is now
items.content:
Today, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate announced that their free-to-play turn-based strategy role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’ is now available on PC via Steam , joining the STOVE client as a new way to play the game. This launch also marks the launch of a new server dubbed “Foundry”. The publisher writes that the “Steam launch is part of a platform expansion reflecting the needs of global players”. With Epic Seven now available on Steam, the world’s largest gaming platform, long-term positive synergy is expected from a new influx of players and improved accessibility. Furthermore, the Steam server introduces exclusive new features, such as controller support. Additionally, a new Special Side Story, “Secret Rabbit Hole,” is live from 29 October to the 10th of December. The Knockout stage of the World Championships are also underway! Though the gist of that is that for the next few weekends, matches will be broadcast live in four languages on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel and Twitch —beginning at 03:00 UTC. More details on that can be found below. Epic Seven is a free-to-play title that is available across PC (Windows) via Steam / STOVE , iOS (macOS supported), and Android via Google Play .

The new “Foundry” server, launched alongside the Steam service, can be accessed not only through Steam but also via the STOVE PC Client and mobile devices. For players starting Epic Seven for the first time, the new server will operate with independent matchmaking for PvP content for a limited time.

Additionally, various events will be held on the new server to help players settle in quickly. A Settlement Support Buff Event, which began on the 29th, provides various effects to accelerate Hero and account growth, along with daily free Hero summons. There will also be bountiful rewards provided, including various Equipment, growth materials, and Hero Skins, when players log in or play through content.

Global player response has also been highly positive, with over 100,000 players participating in the Steam Wishlist Event that began in August.

Meanwhile, Epic Seven will release a Special Side Story, “Secret Rabbit Hole,” from Oct. 29 to Dec. 10. The greatest Bunny detective, Bunny Girl Great Detective Moro, alongside her sidekick, Alencia, will investigate various incidents to stop a plot detected during a victory celebration party, uncovering the hidden truth behind the case along the way.

Players can earn three pieces of Level 88 Equipment by progressing through the story and will receive a special Pet upon collecting all three new Bunny Girl characters and two skins. Additional rewards, such as Charms and Emojis, can also be earned through the concurrent “Trusty Sidekick Alencia’s Case Files” and “Lucky Board Party!” events.

E7WC determines the ultimate global champion of Epic Seven ‘s real-time PvP mode, World Arena. The Knockout Stage will feature 16 players: the 14 survivors from the two-week Group Stage, along with Hazamarei and MagicQi, who secured their Knockout Stage seeds by placing first and second in the newly established online league, “ Epic Seven Masters 2026.”

The Group Stage, held over four days on October 10 (Sat), 11 (Sun), 17 (Sat), and 18 (Sun), delivered incredible matches and top-tier entertainment for Epic Seven fans. In particular, defending champion XiaoXuenai faced elimination after a loss to FN in the Upper Bracket but rallied to win the final match, proving the resilience of a true champion by advancing to the Knockout Stage. In addition, OMEGA from Group E made headlines with an incredible comeback victory, perfectly utilizing “Salome”—a Hero capable of cloning target Heroes—from a heavily disadvantaged position.

The Knockout Stage will be held every weekend at 03:00 UTC for about four weeks, from October 24 to November 14. Like the Group Stage, it will follow a Double-Elimination format to determine the Top 4 players who will advance to the Finals, held at the Lotte Cinema World Tower SUPER PLEX in Jamsil, Korea, on November 28. All matches will be broadcast live in four languages on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel and Twitch .

Smilegate will run a Drops event for viewers tuning in via Twitch and reveal coupon codes during the live broadcast. Additionally, Smilegate will hold an in-game Match Prediction event, allowing players to predict match results and earn rewards.

items.title: Epic Seven Announces Events for Its Official Steam Launch on October 29
items.summary: Ahead of its official Steam launch on October 29, the mobile RPG Epic Seven has revealed a lineup of events, including a new server called "Foundry" and a Steam demo available from October 8 to October 27.
items.content:
Details of the events planned for the official Steam launch of Epic Seven, a mobile RPG operated by Smilegate and developed by SUPER CREATIVE, were released on October 8 (Thursday). The official Steam service is scheduled to begin on October 29 (Thursday).

On October 29 (Thursday), Epic Seven will begin its official service on Steam, one of the world's largest gaming platforms, and the new server "Foundry" will open at the same time.

A series of events will also be held so that players can get used to the game quickly on the new server.

A settling-in support buff event starting on October 29 (Thursday) offers various effects that support the growth of heroes and accounts, including a 30% increase in EXP gain.

Players who reach account level 70 will receive the hero "Luna," and 20 free summons will also be available every day.

In addition, there will be an event in which players can obtain equipment, growth materials, and hero skins by earning and accumulating points through Arena (PvP) content, along with login bonuses.

The new "Foundry" server can be accessed not only through Steam but also through the PC client "STOVE" and on mobile.

Players can also use their existing account information as is to play on Steam.

From October 8 (Thursday) to October 27 (Tuesday), a demo of Epic Seven can be played on Steam.

The demo is available as part of "2026 Steam Next Fest" and lets players try the main story as well as battle content such as "Brawl," "Battlefield of the War God," and "Automaton Tower."

Progress made in the demo will not carry over to the official service.

The Epic Seven app can be downloaded from Google Play and the App Store. More information about the game is available through the official community and the official YouTube channel.

items.title: Epic Seven Pity Odds: 1.5% Rate, $302 Guarantee [2026]
items.summary: Epic Seven's 1.5% base rate has no 50/50 — 121 pulls guarantees your hero for 02-18. See the full cost table and EV math.
items.content:
Epic Seven’s gacha has one feature that sets it apart from almost every other anime-style gacha on the market: there is no 50/50 coin flip. The short answer for anyone deciding whether to chase a specific hero is this – Smilegate sets the base rate for a 5-star hero at 1.5% per pull on a Covenant pickup banner, and backs that up with a hard, deterministic guarantee at 121 pulls that hands you the exact featured hero, not a random 5-star from the wider pool. Priced out in real money, that guarantee runs roughly $302 to $318 depending on how you buy your Skystones, based on Epic Seven’s own currency shop and current App Store pricing.

How Epic Seven’s Summon System Works The Base 5-Star Rate: What 1.5% Really Means Epic Seven’s Biggest Difference: No 50/50 Coin Flip The 121-Pull Hard Pity, Explained Pull-by-Pull Probability Table What It Costs: Skystones, Bookmarks, and the Math Between Them The Pity-Cost Table: Currency and Real Cash at Every Milestone Step-by-Step Expected Value Calculation Five Worked Examples: What Different Budgets Actually Buy How Epic Seven Compares to Other Gacha Pity Systems Myths vs. Facts About Epic Seven’s Gacha Is Chasing a Specific Hero in Epic Seven Worth It? Frequently Asked Questions What is Epic Seven’s base rate for a 5-star hero? Does Epic Seven have a 50/50 system? How many pulls does it take to guarantee a featured hero? How much does it cost to guarantee a hero in Epic Seven? Is it cheaper to buy Skystones in bulk? When does soft pity start in Epic Seven? Is Epic Seven’s rate disclosure considered reliable? Should I save Skystones for a specific banner, or spend as I go? Related Coverage That’s the headline. The rest of this piece walks through where those numbers come from, what a pull-by-pull probability curve looks like under the published 1.5% base rate, a step-by-step expected-value calculation, a worked pity-cost table priced in both Skystones and dollars, and five spending scenarios so you can judge whether saving up for one hero is worth it before you open your wallet.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.

Epic Seven runs its gacha through “Covenant Summons,” which pull from a shared pool of heroes and artifacts. A single summon costs 5 Covenant Bookmarks, and Bookmarks are bought with Skystones, the game’s premium currency, according to BlueStacks’ Epic Seven beginner’s guide . The in-game shop sells 5 Bookmarks for 100 Skystones at the standard rate, or 50 Bookmarks for 950 Skystones as a bulk option, which works out to 95 Skystones per summon instead of 100, per Epic7DB’s currency guide .

The week's biggest stories in tech, gaming and security, in one email.

The banner that matters most for anyone chasing a specific hero is the Covenant “Drop Rate Up” banner, sometimes called a pickup banner, which rotates roughly every one to two weeks and features a single highlighted 5-star hero. As of early September 2026, that rotation included heroes like Uncharted Pioneer Politis on a Drop Rate Up banner starting September 3, and Lisette on a Mystic pull banner from late August, according to the Epic Seven Wiki’s heroes hub , confirming the game is still actively live-serviced with fresh banners rather than winding down.

Every Covenant pickup summon draws from a rarity table where the top tier, 5-star heroes, sits at a flat base rate of roughly 1.5% before any pity boost kicks in, according to a September 2026 update to the Epic Seven Wiki’s summons and pity guide . That rate has crept upward over the game’s history. Older third-party breakdowns from 2019 and 2020 cited figures closer to 1.25% to 1.4% for a 5-star hero, so the current 1.5% figure reflects a modest rate increase Smilegate has made to the base odds over time, not a number that’s stayed frozen since launch.

What makes that 1.5% figure different from base rates in most other gacha games is what happens after it hits. In games like Genshin Impact or Honkai: Star Rail, a 5-star pull is often followed by a second roll of the dice over which specific unit you actually receive. Epic Seven skips that step entirely on pickup banners, which is the single biggest reason its pity math is simpler to calculate than almost anything else in the genre.

Most modern gacha systems layer a 50/50 mechanic on top of their pity count: hit the top rarity, and there’s roughly a coin-flip chance it’s the character the banner is actually selling rather than a generic unit from the standard pool. Epic Seven doesn’t do that on its Covenant pickup banners. The Epic Seven Wiki states it plainly: “Covenant pickup pity is 121 pulls and there is no 50/50,” and that if the banner has a featured hero up, “the 121st yellow is that hero.”

That single design choice changes the entire cost calculation compared to a game like Genshin Impact’s 50/50 pity system , where losing the coin flip can force a second full pity cycle before you’re guaranteed the unit you actually wanted. In Epic Seven, once you’ve committed to a pickup banner, every pull that doesn’t land a 5-star still counts toward the same 121-pull counter, and there’s no branch where you land the top rarity and still walk away without the hero you were saving for.

Epic Seven layers a soft pity ramp on top of the flat base rate starting around pull 100, and that ramp climbs until it reaches a deterministic guarantee at pull 121, per the Epic Seven Wiki’s summons documentation. Put simply: if you haven’t landed the featured hero by your 120th pull on a given pickup banner, your 121st summon is that hero, full stop, no roll involved.

Smilegate hasn’t published the exact per-pull rate curve for the 21 pulls between where soft pity starts and where hard pity locks in, so this article doesn’t estimate specific percentages for that stretch. What’s confirmed is the start point (around pull 100), the endpoint (pull 121, guaranteed), and that the climb in between only raises your odds, never lowers them. That’s enough to build a conservative, fully sourced cost model without guessing at numbers nobody has published.

Using the flat 1.5% base rate that applies through pull 99 (before soft pity begins), the cumulative chance of landing the featured hero at least once follows the standard formula for repeated independent draws: 1 minus (0.985 raised to the power of the pull count). Here’s how that curve looks at common milestones.

items.title: Epic Seven Unveils 8th Anniversary Updates Including Steam Store Page Launch
items.summary: Provided by Epic Seven ©Epic Seven Smilegate announced on Monday, August 24, that Epic Seven, the mobile turn-based strategy RPG developed by Super Creative, revealed details on ne...
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on Provided by Epic Seven

Smilegate announced on Monday, August 24, that Epic Seven, the mobile turn-based strategy RPG developed by Super Creative, revealed details on new content, events, and the opening of its Steam store page through the showcase video "Infinity," celebrating its 8th anniversary of official launch.

The showcase video was released on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel at noon on Saturday, August 22. In the video, Executive Producer Kwang-jin Tak and Development Director Dae-kyun Heo, who lead the planning and development of Epic Seven, shared future update plans and details on interactive offline events for the 8th anniversary.

The news of Epic Seven's expansion to Steam attracted the most attention in the video. Epic Seven will officially launch on Steam within this year, as part of a platform expansion addressing global players' demand for a Steam release. To this end, the Steam store page opened on August 22, launching a Wishlist Event that grants various currencies and items based on the number of wishlists reached. Players can play on Steam through account transfer supported by STOVE, and a new server will also be provided alongside the official Steam launch. The new server will operate as an independent matchmaking server for a set period to accommodate players starting Epic Seven for the first time. In addition, controller support will be added to the Steam service to offer a unique gameplay experience. The exact launch schedule will be announced at a later date.

Various 8th anniversary update details were also unveiled. A new side story Episode, "Paradise Lost," which covers the earliest era in the Epic Seven lore—where the world repeatedly falls into ruin and is rebuilt—will begin on August 27, with new heroes such as "Lisette" and "Uncharted Pioneer Politis" introduced sequentially. A collaboration with Smilegate's another popular IP, Chaos Zero Nightmare (CZN), is also underway. Key combatants from CZN will be added as Epic Seven heroes, along with "Dimensional Exploration," a new roguelike PvE mode. Meanwhile, a new real-time PvP mode, "Call of Chaos," will be added to the World Arena. Players can look forward to unpredictable battles in every match using "Destiny," a powerful effect chosen during combat.

In terms of quality-of-life improvements, the introduction of an offline feature for battle delegation (repeat battling) drew significant interest. Once added, players can collect growth materials through repeat battles while offline, which is expected to further ease the burden of hero progression.

Information on offline events scheduled through the second half of the year, starting with the 8th anniversary celebrations, was also announced. On Saturday, August 29, the "Festival of Everlasting Successors" will be held on the 12th floor of Hyundai Department Store Sinchon Branch with approximately 160 players. Executive Producer Kwang-jin Tak and Development Director Dae-kyun Heo will attend the event to communicate directly with fans. Furthermore, a collaboration cafe will operate on the B2 floor of Hyundai Department Store Sinchon Branch for about a month, from August 29 to September 30. In addition, the global esports tournament to determine the ultimate Epic Seven World Arena champion, the Epic Seven World Championship (E7WC 2026), will kick off on September 12 with in-game qualifiers. The Grand Finals are scheduled to take place on Saturday, November 28 at the Lotte World Tower Super Plex in Jamsil.

Meanwhile, an 8th anniversary event packed with generous rewards will begin on August 27, offering all players a total of 1,260 free Covenant Summons and the bunny girl-themed "Majestic New Moon Luna" skin, which won first place in a player popularity poll.

Detailed information about Epic Seven can be found on the official Epic Seven community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: After Epic Seven, Super Creative Refused to Play It Safe With Chaos Zero Nightmare
items.summary: After Epic Seven, Super Creative explains why Chaos Zero Nightmare embraces psychological horror, meaningful failure, and emotional storytelling instead of another safe anime RPG. Hear from the developers at Anime Expo 2026.
items.content:
A lot of anime RPGs know how to sell desire. They have beautiful characters, stylish animations, limited banners, and enough personality-driven marketing to make players pick a favorite before they’ve even touched the game. I’m of the mind that there’s nothing wrong with that. Games can be attractive, characters can be sexy, and players are allowed to enjoy that part of the fantasy.

Keeping those characters meaningful after the first impression is a little more difficult for some, but Chaos Zero Nightmare seems to thrive in that space. Super Creative already proved it understands character-driven 2D RPGs with Epic Seven , but its new title doesn’t read like a repeat of what this team produced before. Speaking with Noisy Pixel at Anime Expo 2026, Producer and Director Hyungseok Kim, Technical Director Kihyun Kang, and Art Director Hankyung Ryu described a game where attraction, horror, failure, and character attachment sit closer together than usual.

Chaos Zero Nightmare is published by Smilegate and launched globally in October 2025 for PC and mobile as a 2D animation-based RPG with card-based combat and roguelike elements, set in a universe consumed by a force known as Chaos.

After Epic Seven , Super Creative could have taken the most obvious route: a cleaner modern update, larger environments, more 3D presentation, or another project built directly around the same strengths. Instead, Chaos Zero Nightmare leans harder into 2D art, anime influence, psychological horror, and the kind of character drama that asks players to care about more than a design.

When asked about starting a new IP after Epic Seven , Kim said the challenge came from how much had changed at once. “Everything about it was new,” he said. “The genre was different, the game design was different, and because it’s primarily a mobile game, many people didn’t believe it could succeed. Even for me, that uncertainty became one of the biggest challenges.”

There’s a clear confidence in taking that risk, especially in a market where visual appeal alone rarely makes a new anime RPG feel distinct for long. Kim pointed to anime as one place where emotional extremes are handled more openly. “In anime, it’s common to see characters pushed to emotional extremes,” he said. “They break down emotionally, their facial expressions become intense, and terrible things happen to them. You don’t often see those kinds of dramatic portrayals in major mobile games.” I really enjoyed the tone this set as it shows the game isn’t avoiding character appeal, but Kim seems more interested in what can happen after players are already paying attention.

Anime fans understand the value of a strong character design, but memorable characters usually need more than a look. They need pressure, weakness, bad choices, fear, or some kind of emotional consequence. Kim’s comments suggest Chaos Zero Nightmare is trying to bring more of that language into a mobile RPG structure. In the game, characters can be overwhelmed, mentally broken, consumed by monsters, or pushed into situations where the fantasy becomes uncomfortable.

Kim described a similar rhythm when talking about the story and gameplay. “We wanted to tell stories where characters experience collapse, healing, and eventually find a way to move forward again,” he said. “Many games simply reward players with excitement and constant success. We wanted players to experience frustration when they fail, then feel genuine catharsis when they overcome those failures.”

Frustration can be risky in a live-service game, especially one asking players to return often. Kim’s answer doesn’t treat it like a problem to hide. He describes it as part of the intended loop, where failure gives recovery more weight and success carries more than the usual reward screen.

The same confidence comes through in the art direction. While many games continue moving toward larger 3D spaces, Super Creative stayed with the format that helped define its reputation. Ryu said the decision wasn’t difficult because “Super Creative has always been known for its strengths in 2D artwork,” and the team could build on what it learned from Epic Seven .

Rather than treating 2D as a fallback, Ryu talked about it as the right language for what Chaos Zero Nightmare wants to show. Expressions, breakdowns, harsh imagery, and characters losing composure all benefit from illustration that can push emotion beyond realism.

Ryu described the game’s visual identity in direct terms. “One of our defining visual ideas is showing characters in situations where they’re completely broken or devastated,” he said. “You see monsters overwhelming them, characters reaching emotional collapse, and very harsh imagery.”

Sex appeal and horror aren’t treated as separate lanes here. Chaos Zero Nightmare understands the appeal of beautiful characters, then places those characters in violent, unstable, and uncomfortable situations. The result is stylish and attractive, but it also asks for a different kind of reaction than admiration alone.

Kang said the technical side had to support that identity as well. Even with 2D characters, the environments aren’t meant to feel like flat backdrops. They’re built with depth, giving the illustrated look more space and atmosphere without moving away from the studio’s strengths.

items.title: Epic Seven Releases New Shepherd of the Dark Diene Update
items.summary: Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update
items.content:
Posted in: Games , Mobile Games , Video Games | Tagged: Epic Seven , Smilegate , Super Creative

Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update

Smilegate and developer Super Creative has launched a new update for Epic Seven , bringing with it a new character. Players now have access to Shepherd of the Dark Diene, a new Moonlight Hero who brings a different set of attacks and more to the fray, along with a New Year's event to kick off 2026. We have more details here as the content is live today.

Shepherd of the Dark Diene is a country girl who, after encountering a black wolf in the forest, forms a contract with Noias, the Dark Spirit Lord, who has appeared for the first time in centuries. Driven by her admiration for the Hero "Aki" and her unwavering determination, she embarks on her journey to save the world. But as her journey unfolds, it begins to transform into something dark and twisted. She is a 5★ Dark elemental Mage Hero who can lead battles to her advantage by utilizing various effects that trigger when she is granted "immortality." Her Skill 1, "Crimson Claws," inflicts rupture on the enemy, and a successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportionally to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted immortality, it triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

Her Skill 2, "Noias's Guidance," grants immortality for 1 turn at the start of battle. Additionally, when someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating "Dark Moon," which dispels buffs from all enemies, grants immortality to the caster for 3 turns, and increases Combat Readiness by 35%. Her Skill 3, "Endless Darkness," inflicts seal on all enemies for 2 turns, and attacks them before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Also, a successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted immortality, they ignore Effect Resistance.

To celebrate the New Year, Smilegate will also be running several in-game events. First, the "New Year Check-In Event" will run for three weeks until the 22nd. Players can log in to receive a New Year's greeting from Merurin. The New Year's Gift Chest includes Lv. 88 Equipment and "Fire Horse Stamps," which can be used in concurrent events. The second event, "Collect New Year Stamps," will run during the same period. By consuming Energy daily, players can obtain "Leif" and the event currency, "Fire Horse Stamps." In the third event, "New Year's Gift Arrived!," players can use the "Fire Horse Stamps" earned from the two events mentioned earlier to open random chests containing rewards such as MolaGora and Charms. Finally, in the "Merurin's Lucky Pouch" event, players can clear simple missions to earn various rewards, including a final reward of 1,000 Skystone.
